title: Review and resolve semantic implementation feedback
summary: A reviewer can comment across semantic stages, submit feedback for agent-driven history rewriting, inspect resolutions, approve them, and approve the final stack.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The reviewer can comment on requirements or criteria, stage decisions, changed files, and specific diff lines with stable anchors.
One feedback batch can contain comments targeting multiple semantic stages.
Draft comments can be submitted as an immutable batch for agent processing.
Submitted feedback is applied one semantic stage at a time, rewriting that commit and replaying downstream stages while keeping artifacts valid.
The UI shows each feedback item, how it was addressed, the rewritten stage, and its current approval state.
The reviewer can approve resolutions individually or all at once.
When all feedback is resolved and approved, metadata is published separately and the deterministic stage branches are ready for hosting-neutral use.
Feedback state and implementation artifacts are schema-validated and explicit failures are surfaced.
